course_subtitle: Welcome, future genius, to the fun world of artificial intelligence! Here you will have the computer recognize your face, put on funny masks for you, and understand your voice commands to solve mazes. Unlock stations and discover the magic of AI!

stations.title: Station 1: Camera face detection (AI)
stations.desc: Learn how to open the camera and let the AI ​​detect where your face is and draw a green square around it.
stations.story: Welcome, future champion of the Artificial Intelligence Lab! The computer has magic eyes (the camera). We use AI blocks to make it analyze the image and search for faces to pinpoint their location.
stations.simple: Like a mobile camera when you come to photograph someone! You will find small squares appearing on their own on people's faces because the camera focuses on them!
stations.hint: Type in the editor: print("AI camera and face detection turned on successfully") and press Run!
stations.challenge: Print the magic sentence AI Camera and Face Detection Successfully Triggered to simulate face detection.

pills.label: Turn on AI face detection
pills.code: print("The AI ​​camera and face detection has been successfully activated")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The AI ​​camera and face detection were successfully turned on

stations.title: Station 2: Funny facial features and masks
stations.desc: Use Face Landmarks to attach sunglasses and a funny hat directly to your face!
stations.story: Artificial intelligence can determine the location of your eyes, nose, and mouth with extreme accuracy (Landmarks)! We use these points to create cartoon masks that move with you wherever you turn.
stations.simple: Like Snapchat and Instagram filters! As soon as you laugh or move your head, the filter and glasses move with you as if they were real!
stations.hint: Type print("Funny mask overlaid on facial features").
stations.challenge: Print the magic phrase Funny mask fitted to facial features to simulate filters.
stations.starter_code: # Simulate the installation of filters and masks with artificial intelligence:

pills.label: Fitting a face mask
pills.code: print("The funny mask was installed on the facial features")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The funny mask is superimposed on the facial features

stations.title: Station 3: AI animal classification
stations.desc: Train a machine learning model to distinguish between pictures of cats and dogs intelligently and quickly!
stations.story: We can teach computers! We show him 20 pictures of a cat and 20 pictures of a dog, so he studies the features and ears to learn to distinguish between them on his own in the future.
stations.simple: Like a little child when you learn it in a picture book! She tells him this is a cat and this is a dog, and when he sees them in the street, he recognizes them on his own without help!
stations.hint: Type print("Model trained and image labeled: cat").
stations.challenge: Print the magic sentence The model is trained and classifies the image: cat for a machine learning simulation.
stations.starter_code: # Simulate animal classification with machine learning:

pills.label: Animal image classification
pills.code: print("The model has been trained and the image is classified as: cat")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The model is trained and classifies the image: cat

stations.title: Station 4: Solve the maze with voice commands
stations.desc: Program the game to understand your voice! When you say (right) or (left), the object moves to exit the maze.
stations.story: Artificial intelligence understands human speech (Speech Recognition)! We program the microphone to hear our voice commands and convert them into movement commands within the maze game.
stations.simple: Like magic games in science fiction movies! You talk to the computer and say, “Move to the right,” and it starts moving in a second without you touching the keyboard!
stations.hint: Type print("Voice command heard and object moved right").
stations.challenge: Print Voice command heard and object moved right to simulate voice commands.
stations.starter_code: # Simulate voice guidance to solve a maze:

pills.label: Turn on voice guidance
pills.code: print("The voice command was heard and the object moved right")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The voice command is heard and the object moves right

stations.title: Station 5: Track hand and finger movement
stations.desc: Use the AI ​​camera to track the movement of your hand and fingers and subtly count the number of fingers raised!
stations.story: The camera monitors the hand joints (Hand Tracking)! We program artificial intelligence to draw dots on your five fingers and easily recognize your movements and expressive gestures.
stations.simple: Like Kinect and Wii games! You move your hand in the air and the game understands what you are doing and interacts with you immediately!
stations.hint: Type print("Hand movement tracked and 5 raised fingers counted").
stations.challenge: Print the magic sentence Hand movement was tracked and 5 fingers raised were counted to simulate hand tracking.
stations.starter_code: # Hand and finger movement tracking simulation:

pills.label: Hand and finger tracking
pills.code: print("Hand movement was tracked and 5 fingers raised were counted")

validation_rules.required_output_text: Hand movement was tracked and 5 fingers raised were counted

stations.title: Station 6: Driving the rocket with a hand gesture
stations.desc: The grand final stop! Control the flight of the space rocket by moving your hand in the air in front of the camera!
stations.story: The big final stop in artificial intelligence! We will combine hand tracking with the rocket game. When you raise your hand up, the rocket flies, and when you lean right, it heads right to go beyond the planets and space stones!
stations.simple: Like a maestro or a magician! You move your hand in the air in front of the screen and the missile flies behind you as if it were tied to your finger with a magic thread!
stations.hint: Type print("The missile was successfully directed with a hand gesture and the champion wins!").
stations.challenge: Print the closing phrase The rocket was successfully guided with a hand gesture and the hero wins! to celebrate the completion of your superhero project!
stations.starter_code: #Simulate controlling the missile with hand movement:

pills.label: Driving the rocket by hand
pills.code: print("The missile was successfully directed with a hand movement and the hero won!")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The missile was successfully directed with a hand gesture and the hero won!
